title: LLM Streaming Transport & Connection Governance: SSE vs. gRPC vs. WebSockets vs. HTTP/3 QUIC & Client Disconnect Abort Propagation

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Unbuffered-Unaware HTTP/1.1 SSE (proxy_buffering on, No Disconnect Cancel)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Anti-pattern (4KB proxy buffer stalls chunks; dead sockets burn 21% GPU tokens)

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Tuned HTTP/2 SSE (X-Accel-Buffering: no) + TCP FIN/RST Abort Propagation
tiers.recommended_scenario: Standard web/desktop Chat & Copilot text streaming over reliable networks

tiers.tier: Tier 3: East-West gRPC Bidirectional Protobuf Streaming + Native Context Cancellation
Tier 4 (Recommended): Edge HTTP/3 QUIC SSE / WebTransport + Internal gRPC + Instant vLLM Abort
tiers.recommended_scenario: Global mobile/edge + enterprise AI Gateway + real-time voice/multimodal streaming
